title: The Airy line ensemble at the edge of uniform alternating sign matrices
summary: We prove that the height-level path ensemble of a uniform alternating sign matrix converges to the Airy line ensemble near every interior point of the north-west arctic arc. Under the standard bijection, this is equivalently a limit theorem for the osculating paths of the domain-wall six-vertex model at the ice point. The proof has two main inputs. The integrable input is a new Pfaffian formula for rectangular frozen-corner probabilities, from which we obtain one-point convergence of the top path to the GUE Tracy--Widom distribution.
